comparison.objective: Singulate four parcels onto a sorter lane with prescribed gaps and orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Carton pick-and-place, cross-arm staging, orientation, and spatial arrangement.
comparison.success_condition: All parcels lie flat and single-file, long axes along the lane, with at least 10 cm clear gaps and no stacking or side-by-side placement.
comparison.reason: Tests arrangement and handoff of large packages, not precision impact tooling or recovery of millimetre-scale debris.
